summary: Full backend + frontend testing of new Executive Dashboard. Backend: 14/14 dashboard tests pass (test_dashboard.py). /api/dashboard/summary returns correct shape (kpis, financial, project_status, recent_activity, upcoming_tasks, recent_clients) with all 10 KPI keys numeric; kpi math consistent (active+completed == sum(project_status)); no _id leaks. /api/dashboard/search returns 5 groups (clients/projects/invoices/contracts/proposals) with proper isolation and no ObjectID leaks; empty query returns empty groups. Regression endpoints (projects, clients, invoice/config, proposal/sections, contract/sections) all 200. Frontend: Static login click routes to /dashboard successfully. All 10 KPI cards render real values (Total Clients=3, Active=2, Completed=1, Open Tasks=23, Completed Tasks=2, Revenue=$0). KPI click navigation verified (kpi-total_clients->/clients, kpi-open_tasks->/tasks). Quick Actions navigate correctly (create-client->/clients, generate-ai-plan->/projects). Financial Summary widget renders Revenue/Outstanding/Avg Invoice ($8,640) + bar chart with 5 stages. Project Status renders progress bars for Planning/In Progress/Review/Completed. Recent Activity, Upcoming Tasks, Recent Clients all render items. Global Search: typing 'a' calls /api/dashboard/search, results dropdown appears, clicking a search-result-clients item navigates to /clients. Regression: Project Workspace loads with all tabs (Overview, AI Planner, Proposal, Contract, Invoice, AI Chat, Tasks, Documents, Proposals, Notes, Activity). No console errors detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /api/dashboard/search accepts any q length; when q is a single character, regex scan may become expensive at scale. Consider min length 2 or DB text indexes for production.

Minor: Dashboard.jsx line 111 hardcodes finance chart statuses (Draft/Sent/Paid/Overdue/Cancelled). If new statuses are added in INVOICE_STATUSES they won't appear in chart. Consider driving from data.financial.by_status keys.
Note: Pre-existing test_crud.py failures (4) and test_workspace.py env error are unrelated to this sprint - they assume seeded data ordering.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seed data (3 clients, 3 projects, 25 tasks, 1 saved invoice from prior iteration).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executive Dashboard fully functional. Reusable backend test at /app/backend/tests/test_dashboard.py. All data-testids from prompt are present and working. If retesting, note that search dropdown uses 250ms debounce - wait ~500ms after typing before asserting results.
